visual_goal: Show the used-car cycle across one portfolio's products as a loop of generic product tiles with data flowing between them, ending in a market index.
prompt: A circular loop illustration of six generic unbranded product tiles arranged clockwise around a small generic car in the center. Top: a screen with shoppers labeled 'Marketplace'. Right: a website-and-contacts tile labeled 'Website and CRM'. Bottom right: a contract-and-pen tile labeled 'Deal and title'. Bottom left: an auction gavel tile labeled 'Wholesale auctions'. Left: a price-tag-and-clipboard tile labeled 'Appraise and price'. Upper left, slightly outside the loop: a coin-stack tile labeled 'Floorplan finance'. Arrows: from 'Marketplace' to 'Website and CRM' labeled 'leads'; from 'Website and CRM' to 'Deal and title' labeled 'trade-in'; from 'Deal and title' to 'Wholesale auctions' labeled 'aged stock'; from 'Wholesale auctions' to 'Appraise and price' labeled 'wholesale prices'; from 'Appraise and price' to 'Marketplace' labeled 'listings'; from 'Floorplan finance' to 'Appraise and price' labeled 'funds stock'. One extra arrow from 'Wholesale auctions' down to a small line-chart tile below the loop labeled 'Market index'.
alt: A loop of generic product tiles: marketplace, website and CRM, deal and title, wholesale auctions, appraise and price, with floorplan finance funding stock and auctions feeding a market index.

visual_goal: Show one central login linked to separate per-product user stores, each keeping its own roles and dealer mapping.
prompt: A top-to-bottom illustration. At the top, a generic unlabeled dealer employee figure. One arrow down labeled 'signs in once' into a single large key-ring hub labeled 'Central login'. From the hub, four thin chain-link connectors fan downward, each labeled 'linked account', into four separate small generic unbranded database cylinders in a row, each labeled 'User store'. Beneath each cylinder sits its own small padlock-and-org-chart card labeled 'Roles'. The four bottom groups are visibly separate, with clear gaps between them and no lines connecting them to each other.
alt: A dealer employee signs in once to a central login, which is linked to four separate user stores, each with its own roles card.

visual_goal: Show one query passing through a graph gateway that sends a VIN to an existing decoder, gets back a vehicle ID, and uses that ID to join valuation and listing services, each keeping its own storage.
prompt: A left-to-right illustration. Far left: a plain laptop tile labeled 'Product team app'. One arrow labeled 'one query' into a central hexagonal hub labeled 'Graph gateway'; the hub is a plain hexagon with nothing attached to it. Upper right: an older, slightly worn server box labeled 'VIN decoder'. One arrow from 'Graph gateway' to 'VIN decoder' labeled 'VIN', and one return arrow from 'VIN decoder' back to 'Graph gateway' labeled 'vehicle ID'. Right: a gauge tile labeled 'Valuation' and below it a gavel-and-listing tile labeled 'Listings and auctions'. One arrow from 'Graph gateway' to each of them, each labeled 'vehicle ID'. Only the three service boxes on the right ('VIN decoder', 'Valuation', 'Listings and auctions') each have their own small database cylinder beside them; the laptop and the hub have none.
alt: A product team app sends one query to a graph gateway; the gateway sends a VIN to an existing VIN decoder, gets a vehicle ID back, and passes it to valuation and to listings and auctions, each with its own database.

visual_goal: Show six integration layers as a rising staircase of dated steps, each a different kind of shared thing.
prompt: A left-to-right rising staircase of exactly six wide steps, each step a different accent color with a small icon on top and a two-line label printed on the step's front face (year on the first line, word on the second line); each label appears once only. First step with a cloud icon: '2018' / 'Infrastructure'. Second step with a clipboard icon: '2019' / 'Governance'. Third step with a key icon: '2020-21' / 'Login'. Fourth step with a database icon: '2022' / 'Data'. Fifth step with a connected-nodes icon: '2024' / 'API graph'. Sixth and highest step with a puzzle piece in a screen: '2026' / 'Embedded features'. One gentle arrow rising above the stairs from the first step to the sixth.
alt: A rising staircase of six dated steps: 2018 infrastructure, 2019 governance, 2020-21 login, 2022 data, 2024 API graph, 2026 embedded features.
